project.name: Grocery Ledger
project.status: v1 + categories + category management/totals + update install implemented; physical-device QA pending
project.last_verified: 60 JVM + 5 instrumentation tests passed; lint 0 errors; signed 1.3.2 release APK built

status_values.done: Implemented and verified where verification is available
status_values.partial: Implemented but a documented optional or validation item is outstanding
status_values.deferred: Explicitly out of the current release

nodes.label: Grocery Ledger
nodes.summary: Offline-first INR grocery expense tracker with a calendar, item entries, totals, autocomplete, CSV backup, and a manual GitHub update check.

nodes.label: MainActivity
nodes.summary: Single activity; enables edge-to-edge and hosts the Compose tree.

nodes.label: AppContainer
nodes.summary: Manual dependency wiring for Room, repositories, settings, backup, and update checker.

nodes.label: MainViewModel
nodes.summary: Owns selected date/month, totals, day sheet, editor, autocomplete, recent-item chips, import preview, update state, and snackbar events.

nodes.label: GroceryLedgerApp composable
nodes.summary: Theme, navigation between Calendar and Settings, lifecycle refresh, snackbar events, and sheet hosting.

nodes.label: CalendarScreen
nodes.summary: Month header, summary card, weekday header, six-row day grid, FAB, and day sheet trigger.

nodes.label: DaySheet
nodes.summary: Selected-day item list, item count, exact total, empty state, and add/edit/price-history entry actions.

nodes.label: PriceHistorySheet
nodes.summary: Full-screen per-item history: latest and previous price, change text, stats grid, trend chart and tap-to-edit list.

nodes.label: ShoppingListScreen
nodes.summary: Scratch shopping list: add item with optional amount, check off, delete, clear, and convert checked items to today's entries.

nodes.label: EntrySheet
nodes.summary: Add/edit/delete form, autocomplete suggestions, last-price chip, recent-item chips, date picker, discard confirmation, and save actions.

nodes.label: SettingsScreen
nodes.summary: Week start, theme, category rename/delete, CSV export/import, delete all, update check, download/install dialogs, about, and confirmation/preview dialogs.

nodes.label: Compose theme
nodes.summary: Material 3 light/dark theme, dynamic color on Android 12+, green fallback, and system-bar appearance.

nodes.label: Money
nodes.summary: Integer-paise parsing, INR Indian grouping, compact cell formatting, CSV formatting, and the ₹10,00,000 entry cap.

nodes.label: DateRanges
nodes.summary: Monday/Sunday week ranges, calendar months, 42-day grids, labels, and UTC date-picker conversion.

nodes.label: SuggestionRanker
nodes.summary: Pure prefix → word-start → contains ranking, then usage, recency, and alphabetical tie-breaks.

nodes.label: Price history calculator
nodes.summary: Pure PricePoint/PriceStats/PriceHistory models, integer tenths-of-percent maths, and chart sampling.

nodes.label: Domain models
nodes.summary: Expense, daily totals, item suggestions, spending summary, app settings, week start, and theme mode.

nodes.label: Repository interfaces
nodes.summary: Expense and settings contracts used by the ViewModel and implemented by the data layer.

nodes.label: Room storage and offline repository
nodes.summary: Entries, daily totals, suggestions, categories, CRUD, transactions, undo restore, import rebuild, and clear-all. Schema v2 with an additive migration.

nodes.label: item_catalog cache
nodes.summary: Derived suggestion/last-price table; updated transactionally and rebuildable from entries.

nodes.label: CSV backup format
nodes.summary: Version-2 writer/parser (category column), v1 import, BOM, RFC 4180 quoting, UUID dedupe, row validation, newer-version rejection.

nodes.label: CSV file-picker integration
nodes.summary: Reads/writes ContentResolver streams on IO and turns analysis into a repository import.

nodes.label: DataStore settings
nodes.summary: Persists week start and theme with safe defaults for missing or unknown values.

nodes.label: GitHub update checker
nodes.summary: Manual GitHub Releases API check, semver comparison, release metadata/digest parsing, APK download with checksum and signature verification, installer handoff, timeouts, and friendly failures.

nodes.label: Calendar and period navigation
nodes.summary: Current-month grid, per-day totals, Today, previous/next month, adjacent-month days, and future-date blocking.

nodes.label: Item entries
nodes.summary: Name, amount, date, add/edit/delete, undo, save-and-add-another, validation, and discard handling.

nodes.label: Day/week/month totals
nodes.summary: Exact paise sums for the selected day, its Monday/Sunday week, and its calendar month; live Flow updates.

nodes.label: Autocomplete
nodes.summary: Two-character trigger, 120 ms debounce, six ranked suggestions, recent-item quick-add chips, case/whitespace normalization, and free text.

nodes.label: Last-price memory
nodes.summary: Shows the latest price/date per suggestion and lets the user reuse that price with a chip.

nodes.label: Undo delete
nodes.summary: Five-second snackbar; the event carries its own deleted entry so concurrent deletes cannot undo the wrong one.

nodes.label: CSV export and import
nodes.summary: User-controlled backup, duplicate-safe merge, preview counts, error lines, format versioning, and restore.

nodes.label: Manual update check
nodes.summary: Settings button checks GitHub Releases, compares versions, shows notes, and offers Download and install plus the release page. No automatic polling.

nodes.label: Settings
nodes.summary: Week start, theme, backup/restore, delete all, update check, privacy note, and version display.

nodes.label: State restoration
nodes.summary: Selected date survives process death via SavedStateHandle; editor drafts survive configuration changes, not process death.

nodes.label: CAL-1..CAL-9
nodes.summary: Calendar Must items implemented. CAL-9 spend-intensity shading is deferred.

nodes.label: DAY / ENT requirements
nodes.summary: Day sheet and add/edit/delete/undo/save-and-add-another requirements implemented.

nodes.label: SUG requirements
nodes.summary: SUG-1..10 implemented: suggestions, ranking, price memory, and recent-item chips.

nodes.label: PRICE requirements
nodes.summary: PRICE-1..7 implemented: history list, change stats, chart, single-purchase state, tap-to-edit, 500-point cap.

nodes.label: BUD requirements
nodes.summary: BUD-1..4 implemented: optional device budget, progress card, integer-paise maths, not exported.

nodes.label: UNIT requirements
nodes.summary: UNIT-1..6 implemented: optional quantity/unit, thousandths storage, normalized unit price, schema and CSV v3 with old-version import.

nodes.label: SHOP requirements
nodes.summary: SHOP-1..4 implemented: device-only list, add/check/delete/clear, checked priced items become today's entries.

nodes.label: WIDGET requirements
nodes.summary: WIDGET-1..3 implemented: today total plus quick-add action, refresh on app pause and every 30 minutes.

nodes.label: TOT requirements
nodes.summary: Day, week, month, paise arithmetic, formatting, empty state, and midnight refresh implemented.

nodes.label: SET / DAT requirements
nodes.summary: Settings, persistence, auto backup, versioned CSV, dedupe, import preview, and no-auto-delete implemented.

nodes.label: SET-1..SET-7
nodes.summary: Week start, theme, export, import, delete all, about/privacy, and fixed INR implemented.

nodes.label: UPD-1..UPD-6
nodes.summary: Manual GitHub Releases check, version comparison, notes, verified in-app download/install, browser fallback, scoped permissions, and release policy implemented.

nodes.label: NFR requirements
nodes.summary: Offline-first, accessibility, localization, SDK, privacy, tests, and size done; device performance/200% font QA pending.

nodes.label: MNT requirements
nodes.summary: Layers, docs, versioned data, signing, build/test done; migration test infrastructure awaits the first migration; CI optional.

nodes.label: ADR 0001: offline single-module architecture
nodes.summary: One app module, package seams, manual DI, pure domain, exported Room schemas, stable signing.

nodes.label: Versioned CSV with stable UUIDs
nodes.summary: format_version=2 with category, entry_uid dedupe, merge-only import, RFC 4180, UTF-8 BOM; v1 still imports.

nodes.label: Stable release signing
nodes.summary: Keystore outside the repo; same package/key and increasing versionCode for in-place updates.

nodes.label: ADR 0002: GitHub Releases update check
nodes.summary: Manual API check, browser fallback; in-app download/install added by decision.in-app-update; no background polling.

nodes.label: JVM test suite
nodes.summary: 58 JVM tests plus 5 instrumentation tests (Room v1-to-v2 migration and APK verifier): money, dates, ranking, Room repository, category management, CSV v1/v2, update parsing/versioning, APK download checksum/size handling, entry-sheet state, activity, calendar/settings/add-entry UI.

nodes.label: Price history design
nodes.summary: Proposed UX, queries, pure stats, tests and rollout for per-item price history; not implemented yet.

nodes.label: GitHub repository
nodes.summary: Public source repository.

nodes.label: GitHub Releases API/page
nodes.summary: Update source. Release v1.1.0 is published with a signed APK asset and is marked latest.

nodes.label: v1 built
nodes.summary: Feature set implemented, tests pass, signed release APK built.

nodes.label: Physical-device QA
nodes.summary: Visual, performance, accessibility scaling, and install-over-update checks on a real phone. Emulator QA (AVD gl36, API 36, AEHD) now covers the 1.4.0 to 1.5.0 in-app update, a 200% font pass (fixed in 1.5.1) and a 19,697-entry import; launcher placement, TalkBack and the OS install prompt still need a physical device.

nodes.label: Per-item price history
nodes.summary: Chart of prices for an item over time; existing entries already contain the data.

nodes.label: Category filtering
nodes.summary: Filter the day/week/month summary and day sheet to one category. Monthly totals are done.

nodes.label: Monthly budget
nodes.summary: A target for the existing month total, with progress.

nodes.label: Recent-item chips
nodes.summary: Up to five chips under an empty name field; one tap fills name, last price and last category.

nodes.label: Price history
nodes.summary: Every recorded purchase of one item with change versus the previous purchase, average/low/high, trend chart, tap-to-edit, and a 500-point cap.

nodes.label: Category filter
nodes.summary: Chips under the summary narrow day/week/month totals, calendar day amounts and the day sheet to one category.

nodes.label: Monthly budget
nodes.summary: Optional DataStore budget with a progress card: spend, remaining or over-budget; hidden while a category filter is active.

nodes.label: Unit price
nodes.summary: Optional quantity and unit (kg, g, L, ml, piece) with a derived per-kg, per-litre or per-piece preview and display; schema and CSV v3.

nodes.label: Shopping list
nodes.summary: Device-only list with optional amounts; checked priced items convert into today's entries and leave the list. Schema v4.

nodes.label: Home-screen widget
nodes.summary: Today's total plus a one-tap add action that opens the add form; refreshes on app pause and every 30 minutes.

nodes.label: Home-screen widget
nodes.summary: Read-only recent totals or quick add.

nodes.label: Automatic update check
nodes.summary: Optional daily check and non-blocking update notification; requires a privacy/UX decision. Manual in-app install is already implemented.

nodes.label: Entry categories
nodes.summary: Optional category per entry, presets plus custom, Uncategorized default, shown in the day sheet. Settings can rename or delete categories; renames follow entries and deletes move them to Uncategorized. The calendar shows monthly totals by category. Schema v2 and CSV v2 (v1 still imports).

nodes.label: In-app update download and install
nodes.summary: Download and install from the update dialog: cache download, size/SHA-256 check, package/version/signing-certificate verification, then Android's installer. The release page remains the browser fallback.

nodes.label: Verified in-app update install
nodes.summary: User-started download only; cache-scoped FileProvider; 100 MB cap; GitHub digest plus package/version/signature checks; REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES only for the installer handoff. Browser release page kept as fallback.

nodes.label: Monthly category totals
nodes.summary: Collapsible By category card under the Day/Week/Month summary. Lists each category total and item count for the selected month, ordered by spend, including Uncategorized.
